cases.description: A newly instantiated Message has no Header set. Calling getHeader() should return null.

After creating a Header with known fields (e.g., id=0x1234, flags=0x8000) and assigning it to the Message via setHeader(Header), getHeader() must return the exact same Header instance (object identity).

When a Message with a non‑null Header is cloned, the cloned Message’s getHeader() should return a Header that is equal to the original’s Header (either the same reference or an equivalent copy, depending on the clone implementation).
Setting a Header that contains edge‑case values (maximum id, zero flags) and then invoking getHeader() must return a Header reflecting those exact values.
